C Casa Gioia Baked for beautiful moments 2026

A hand lettered Casa Gioia script, a CG monogram in an orange oval, and the line 'Baked for beautiful moments' on a sticker that travels across every piece.

Chocolate, cream, sky blue and orange, with a CG repeat pattern for wraps and bags.

Bags, cups, cookie boxes, cake boxes and counter signs, including the Dolce Gioia line for sweets.
